summary: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a common sequela following COVID-19. Although cognitive dysfunction is one of the most debilitating symptoms in ME/CFS, effective therapies are limited. Acupuncture is an important complementary and alternative therapy for ME/CFS and has been shown to have positive effects on cognitive dysfunction in other diseases.
